plans.note: No monetary cap located; liability regime is built from p0240 (liability limited to express provisions; several and not joint), p0126/p0127 (PG members not liable; no representations or warranties re Supply Contract, Wet Segment reliability, integration) and p0241 (mutual cross-indemnity), with p0276 (no admission of liability without Management Committee approval). Assess mutuality and the absence of an aggregate cap and consequential-damages exclusion; several-not-joint liability benefits us.

Not missing: p0241 (21.2) is a reciprocal each-Party indemnity for claims arising from ownership of APCN 2, and Paragraph 32 (p0275-p0280) governs third-party claims, notice, no admission or settlement without Management Committee approval, and survival. No IP-infringement indemnity surfaced; confirm across Paragraph 32 pagination and note the multilateral (not vendor-to-customer) structure.

No non-compete or field-of-use restriction found; 'compete' hits are only 'competent jurisdiction/tribunal'. p0206/p0208 confirm Parties may sell IRU and use Allocated Capacity 'without any restrictions' - freedom-preserving, do not flag.
No supply exclusivity or sole-source obligation located. The only 'exclusive' hit (p0262) is the sole-and-exclusive dispute remedy, which belongs under GOVLAW; confirm and mark not applicable.

Direction check: p0220 requires transiting/inland facilities on terms 'no less favorable than those granted to another Carrier'; p0225 requires arrangements to be reasonable and non-discriminatory. These run mutually among Parties and largely favour us as a capacity acquirer; verify we are not the sole obligor before treating as burdening.
No hits for solicit, employ, personnel or recruit anywhere in the document; likely no non-solicitation clause and nothing to flag.

Exit rights sit in Paragraph 18: p0228 (25-year Initial Period; any Party may terminate its participation at end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter on notice - read the notice period in full), p0229 (termination during Initial Period only by unanimous written agreement), p0231/p0233 (cost consequences; no credit for capital costs on withdrawal), p0234/p0235 (asset realization). Assess the no-exit-during-25-years plus forfeiture against the fallback.

No auto-renewal mechanic; instead a 25-year Initial Period continuing until decommissioning or termination (p0228; p0230 two-thirds decommissioning vote). Treat continuation-in-force as the analogue and assess exit ease and notice window; no renewal price uplift to cap.

No express governing-law clause located (searches for 'laws of the State' and 'construed in accordance' returned nothing). Dispute resolution is p0262 (refer to Management Committee, which may determine arbitration; sole and exclusive remedy), with p0239 (privilege for arbitration documents) and p0260 (general compliance with applicable laws). Confirm absence of governing law and evaluate the committee/arbitration-only remedy against the courts position.

Paragraph 22: p0246 (general bar on assignment, sale, transfer or disposal during the term, subject to 22.2-22.5) and p0254 (written notice when exercising 22.2-22.5). Worker must paginate 22.2-22.5 for affiliate/successor carve-outs and consent standards. p0269 (Successors Bound) supports permitted-successor binding; p0189 is a distinct capacity-assignment mechanic - do not double-flag. No change-of-control termination right surfaced.

No work-product or customer-data IP clause; ownership here is asset ownership: p0107/p0119 (Paragraph 4 ownership of Segments and Wet Segment per Schedule B), p0187/p0210/p0214 (capacity held on ownership basis; schedule updates), p0054 (IRU conveys no ownership). Data is protected via Paragraph 31 confidentiality (p0270-p0273). Nothing assigns our IP or data to counterparties; likely compliant with a note.

Closest analogue is the Terminal Station Right of Use grant: p0179 (grant to Parties accessing at terminal stations), p0182 (no additional charges), p0183 (pre-commencement rights), p0184 (grant extended to IRU purchasers), plus p0054 (IRU indefeasible, no ownership/voting) and p0206-p0208 (onward IRU sales without restriction, life of system). Check revocability, duration and coverage of affiliates, contractors and IRU purchasers.

Paragraph 9 (p0160 keeping and inspection of books; p0165 books/records of billed costs; p0167 any Party's right to review or audit relevant books, records, vouchers and accounts) plus p0177 (inspection of O&M at inspecting Party's own expense) and p0123 (access to inspect equipment and installation). These reciprocal cost-verification rights also benefit us; check notice, frequency and cost allocation and do not flag rights in our favour.

Direction check on amounts payable by us: p0255 (default on payment plus cure period and consequences), p0256 (reclaim of assigned capacity with no payment or credit to the defaulting Party), p0153 (interest on late payment at prime/minimum commercial lending rate), p0233 (no capital-cost credit on withdrawal). Assess forfeiture-style remedies as penalties; avoid double-flagging the withdrawal-credit point already noted under T4C.

Effectively a disclaimer, not a warranty: p0126 (PG makes no representations or warranties) and p0127 (no warranty as to Supplier performance of the Supply Contract, Wet Segment reliability, or integration; nothing construed as a warranty or guarantee). Check whether Supply-Contract warranties flow through to Parties in Paragraph 4 before concluding.

Not a vendor-insurance covenant: p0139 (each Party may insure its own share at its own expense; joint insurance costs become Capital Costs if approved by the Management Committee) and p0133 (insurance or reasonable allowance in lieu as a cost element). No mandatory limits, E&O or cyber cover located; consider whether permissive self-insurance meets the fallback in a consortium build.

No take-or-pay language; analogue is the Minimum Investment Unit definition (p0055) and the Schedule B Investment Share / cost-allocation regime (p0040, p0187) billed per p0165. Assess whether the committed investment share plus O&M allocation operates as a minimum commitment and whether the Paragraph 18 exit supplies the required way out; do not double-flag the exit terms.

End-of-life mechanics exist in Paragraph 18 (p0230 decommissioning by two-thirds; p0234/p0235 liquidation and realization of assets per Schedule B interests and execution of transfer documents; p0231/p0233 withdrawal consequences) and p0280 (obligations survive termination). No data-return or transition-assistance obligation located; confirm across Paragraph 18 and 32 pagination before calling it missing.
